$comment: Art for things that live in a save rather than in data/: residents made in the character creator (by character id) and named pets (by owner id and name), plus pictures of places, the bus, the city and concept posters. Paths are relative to the livera folder. tests/test_cast.cpp checks that every path exists, that no resident here is a founding character (their art is linked from data/characters), and that place and stop ids are real. Facts on the cards were checked against the game's data; anything the card gets wrong is listed under notes so nobody mistakes it for the game's state.

theo-grant.name: Theo Grant
notes: Card occupation is Shift Supervisor, Greenleaf Market; from Day 29 of the recording he works the front desk at Body & Balance.

kai-morgan.name: Kai Morgan

Card home is 3 Founders Row; Harper and Pepper move to 8 Willow Lane on Day 32 of the recording.
The stop shelters are crops of the bus collage's bottom row, numbered 1-7 in route order; they are small (about 306x191) and carry no stop names.
The side view is a crop on a grey studio background, not a transparent sprite.
Stages 2, 3 and 4 have no panorama yet. construction.jpg is a building site, not a city stage.

Concept posters only. Their districts (Riverfront, The Ridge, The Nine, The Meadows...), 'Riverview Park' and the street layout are not the game's; the real places and bus stops are in data/world and data/transit.
